body:
I haven't generally been into Molly lately. It seems to have a bit of an edge for me. But I recently took .2 grams of Molly cut with 2cb, along with some wine. I had the minor initial anxieties when it started to kick in, but after that it was cool.
Once I took the pill of 2cb (not sure what that is in weight), I was in a cool, mellow psychedelic state. It lasted for a couple hours. I was in a rave-type setting, with awesome lights, music, lasers, and people, all which were very positive. I was experiencing minor visuals, which were pleasant. It was a great combination.
